list: The official 55 trophies as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Names, descriptions, grades and PSN progress targets are the official ones; the guides are this entry's own words.

exophase.label: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (names, descriptions, grades)

psnprofiles.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (grades and PSN progress targets)

outputlag.label: OutputLag — GTA 6 Trophy List (launch-era guide, methods and missable notes)

egamers.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List (which trophies are still unconfirmed)

gtavibes.label: GTA Vibes — GTA 6 Trophy List (hidden trophies and the one missable)

honesty: GTA 6 launched 19 Nov 2026, a day before this guide was written. No guide yet confirms every trigger: where a method comes from a launch-era guide it is cited, and where nothing is confirmed the guide says so plainly instead of inventing a location. Check the cited source for the newest findings before you chase a cryptic trophy.

roadmap.title: Before you start: save discipline
roadmap.body: GTA 6 has no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a missed one-off cannot be replayed. Keep one manual save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission (15 manual slots plus one autosave). Never use cheats on your trophy save: they should switch off trophies and saving. Source: OutputLag guide.

roadmap.title: Play the story, Chapters 1 to 5
roadmap.body: The 12 story trophies pop as you finish chapters and named missions, so they cannot be missed — just play. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene. During Chapter 1, do the one thing this guide flags as missable (stage 3).

roadmap.title: The one thing you can miss
roadmap.body: Positive Mental Attitude needs a meditation on Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1, which is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. Everything else stays available after the credits. Source: OutputLag and GTABase/PowerPyx via EGamers.

roadmap.title: Side stories and strangers
roadmap.body: Finish the five side-character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) and 8 stranger strands. The time-sensitive race in Yago's street racing strand, Race Against Yago in Chapter 3, counts toward Strangers & Freaks — save first, then race when it appears. Source: OutputLag guide.

roadmap.title: Partner play and robberies
roadmap.body: Once Jason and Lucia can switch and team up (Chapter 2), do the partner trophies and the robbery set: jewelry stores open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, bank vaults after the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4. Source: OutputLag guide.

roadmap.title: Activities, skills and the open world
roadmap.body: Work through the skill and activity trophies — 250 stunts, 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 14 drone race locations, 20 race wins, fishing, arcade, Combat Focus, the VCIA departure and the tank — while you explore. Most of these fill up naturally if you vary what you do instead of grinding one thing.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration
roadmap.body: Cards (3 sets), WAiNK locations (100), vehicles (100 discovered), all 52 areas of Leonida, the 18 meditation spots and Bret's hunting questline. Scan traffic with the WAiNK app as you drive — it counts as discovering a vehicle — and meditate with your partner along so outdoor spots count twice. Source: OutputLag guide.

roadmap.title: Money and property
roadmap.body: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, spend $100,000 across all shops, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles with the Scooter Bros app. The garages cost about $160,000 together and need the Vice City Real Estate app, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Source: OutputLag guide.

roadmap.title: The cryptic five, then 100%
roadmap.body: Five trophies have no confirmed trigger yet (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin). Try what their descriptions literally say, check the cited guides for new findings, and do not burn hours on them early. Last, clean up the 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, visible after the story) and the platinum pops. Source: OutputLag guide; unconfirmed status per EGamers/PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is no separate task. Work the roadmap in order: story first, the Chapter 1 meditation while you are there, then side stories, robberies, activities, collectibles and money, and finally the 100% checklist. Around 200 hours is the going estimate for the full list, so treat this as a long project, not a weekend. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the time estimate from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the game. It is unmissable: just play the story from the start and it pops when the mission ends. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene, so do not worry if it does not pop the instant the chapter's final mission ends. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before this chapter closes — that is the one thing in the whole list you can miss. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the chapter-pop note and the missable warning from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia should open up during this chapter, which also unlocks the partner trophies — call your partner in once you can switch. Unmissable, like every chapter trophy. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the switching note from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Two things to do while you are in this chapter: the time-sensitive race Race Against Yago in Yago's street racing strand (it shows an hourglass icon and counts toward Strangers & Freaks — save first, then race), and the mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which hands you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies for Sneakthief. The chapter trophy itself is unmissable. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the Chapter 3 notes from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Near the end of this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens bank vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal, so take it when it appears. The chapter trophy itself is unmissable. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the vault-mission note from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Because there is no mission replay, keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission — it is your safety net for anything tied to the ending. The trophy is unmissable as long as you finish the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the no-replay warning from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when the story brings it to you. Named-mission trophies like this one are unmissable — play the story and they pop in order. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed — it pops when the mission ends. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission trophy: unmissable, it pops when the mission ends. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission trophy: unmissable, it pops when the mission ends. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission trophy: unmissable, it pops when the mission ends. It also introduces the airport, which matters later for Catch Me If You Can. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission trophy: unmissable, it pops when the mission ends. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but work you do earlier still counts, so do not wait for the list to appear before starting the grinds. The checklist is stricter than the individual trophies in places: 300 stunts (not 250), 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. Guides rank this the hardest trophy in the list, not because any one task is hard but because it is long. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/100); the checklist details from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, so vary your approach instead of repeating one jump — the game counts the type, not just the trick. Keep going past 250: 100% completion needs 300. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/250); the stunt types and the 300 figure from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PSN tracks this one 0 to 9, so after each new activity check your progress counter to see it move — that tells you which types the game counts. Work through what the map offers: fishing, racing, the shooting range, drone races, the arcade, bowling, the gym, meditation and hunting are the obvious candidates. You only need to try each once, not win or finish it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/9).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There should be two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them, so visit both and work through every challenge at each. Gold is the top medal, so expect to repeat the harder challenges — learn each one's layout first, then go for the gold time or score. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/42); the two-range detail from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. You need at least one win per location, not a win in every race — so learn each course's line once, win it, and move on. Keep a note of which locations you have won at; the counter is 0 to 14 on PSN. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/14); the per-location rule from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word — winning the same race 20 times does not count, so work through the race list and tick each new one off. Street races, including the ones in Yago's strand, are the natural place to start. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/20).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing opens with the story, and Cal is the rival the game sets against you — take his challenge and out-fish him. It is a contest, not a single catch, so watch what the challenge scores (bigger fish, more fish, or both) and fish to that, not just to the biggest bite. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade machine, pick a game and play it through to its end — you only need to finish one, not beat a high score. If a game has no clear end, pick a different cabinet: a game with rounds or levels is the safer choice. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush and nothing here is missable — finish Andy's strand when you reach it. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the after-credits note and the Strangers & Freaks exception from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Like the other side-story finales, it stays open after the credits, so finish Kenton's strand at your own pace — nothing here is missable. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the after-credits note from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so this one cannot be missed — finish Billy's strand when you reach it. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the after-credits note and the Strangers & Freaks exception from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because each has its own trophy, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish to see which ones moved it. One strand needs care: Race Against Yago, a Chapter 3 race in Yago's street racing strand, is time-sensitive (it shows an hourglass icon) — save first, then race the moment it appears. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/8); the exceptions and the Yago warning from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so finish Randy's strand at your own pace — nothing here is missable. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the after-credits note from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so this one cannot be missed. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the after-credits note and the Strangers & Freaks exception from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Bring your partner every time: each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, which halves the travelling. THE MISSABLE ONE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward this trophy and disappears after that chapter. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning — a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time — she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate; follow her and accept the optional task. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. GTABase and PowerPyx flag this as the only trophy that might be missable. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/18); the method and the missable warning from the OutputLag guide; the only-missable flag from GTABase/PowerPyx via EGamers.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks — follow the questline's targets rather than hunting at random. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt grades. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the questline detail from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a set completes when you hold every card in it, so track which sets are one card short and hunt those cards specifically instead of collecting at random. Three sets is the trophy — more sets help 100%, but are not needed for this one. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/3).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app at locations across Leonida — the same app that scans vehicles for Whip It Good — and work through the map region by region so you do not keep re-checking the same streets. The counter is 0 to 100 on PSN. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/100).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges — open the list and pick off the ones closest to done instead of grinding blind. Many complete on their own while you play, and 100% completion needs 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50 if you are chasing the platinum. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/50); the Challenges menu and the 70-of-80 figure from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The easiest setup is a bank vault job: it gives you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns this. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area — keep driving until the heat is fully gone. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the vault setup and the heat-zone rule from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks, so keep the heat up between shops and move fast. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before you hit a fourth. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the method and the delay from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of only counting cars you steal — a quick scan of every new model you pass adds up fast. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/100); the scanning rule and the 200-of-277 figure from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle — Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it to stretch the window. All five must fall before Focus ends. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the controls and the setup from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. Steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count, and the planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the method from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the location from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies — go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it, because kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the method from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Five vaults is the trophy, but 100% completion needs all eight, so keep going. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/5); the method and the 8-vault figure from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away — and keep going until you are out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, because this trophy only pops once the heat is fully gone. Pair it with a vault run if you want the 4-star escape practice. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the heat-zone rule from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The counter is 0 to 52 on PSN, so open your map and look for the areas you have never set foot in — the gaps are usually the small towns and the corners of the map, not Vice City itself. Driving through an area counts as exploring it, so a slow tour of the state closes this out. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/52).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One per gang is the trophy — check which gangs you have hit and target the ones left. 100% completion wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops along the way if you are thorough. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/9); the 39-operations figure from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Honest answer: no guide has confirmed the exact trigger for this one yet. The official description is the only solid hint — a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — so once you are free-roaming, try the beachfront bars along Ocean Beach and order a drink where you can see the water. PowerPyx marks this trophy as not yet known, and this guide will not invent a bar name or a step nobody has verified. Check the cited guides for the newest findings before you chase it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the unconfirmed status from EGamers/PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Honest answer: no guide has confirmed the exact trigger for this one yet. The description says to smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — the classic style points at driving a car straight through a showroom's glass front, the way the old games did it. Try it at a showroom once you are free-roaming, but treat that as an educated try, not a verified method: PowerPyx marks this trophy as not yet known. Check the cited guides for the newest findings before you chase it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the unconfirmed status from EGamers/PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — which is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the method from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is cryptic — 'a partnership with mass appeal' — and no guide has fully confirmed the trigger yet. The best report so far says it should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength: buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Treat that as reported, not verified, and check the cited guides before you grind Strength to the top for this alone. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the reported method from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up through normal play without a separate grind — just keep playing the way the game rewards and check the counter (0 to 500 on PSN) now and then. If it is lagging near the end, pick up more robberies and illegal operations rather than quiet side content. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/500); the feeding rule from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Honest answer: the exact trigger is still unverified. 'Second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt — a retry, a rematch, a second try at a failed event — but no guide has confirmed which one, and the trophy's own description is the whole hint. Do not chase this one specifically yet; play normally and check the cited guides for the newest findings. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the unverified status from EGamers.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Honest answer: the exact trigger is still unverified. The description — 'What the hell just happened?' — points at witnessing something strange, a hidden encounter somewhere in Leonida, but no guide has confirmed where or what. Explore odd corners of the map, watch for strange events while free-roaming, and check the cited guides for the newest findings before you go hunting for it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the unverified status from EGamers.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Honest answer: the precise conditions are still under investigation. The description says to bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — knocking a person down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, like a bowling strike. Try it on a pedestrian from a slow-moving car with a melee weapon out, but treat that as an educated try: no guide has confirmed the exact conditions yet. Check the cited guides for the newest findings. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; the under-investigation status from EGamers.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs — launder them by selling them to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so it adds up across the whole game: do the vault and payday jobs as they come and sell the bills on, and the trophy pops in the background. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/250000); the method from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so it builds up through normal play — weapons, clothes, food, car mods, all of it counts. If you are short near the end, buy something expensive you actually want (a car mod or a weapon) rather than throwing money at junk. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/100000); the cumulative rule from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000 — and garages the story gives you do not count, so you need to buy all eight yourself. Buy them before you start registering cars for On the Spot, since each car needs a free garage space. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/8); the method and the cost from the OutputLag guide.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens through the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (Little Boxes) and register cheap cars you do not mind keeping. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles (target 0/10); the method from the OutputLag guide.
